name: Satisfiable 3-CNF solving
description: Return {"assignment": [booleans]}; score 1 iff every clause is satisfied. Literal k refers to assignment[abs(k)-1], negated when k < 0.

sources.locator: Problem family; original benchmark protocol is not claimed.

execution.interface: Return {"assignment": [booleans]}; score 1 iff every clause is satisfied. Literal k refers to assignment[abs(k)-1], negated when k < 0.

limitations: Portable reference implementation, not a reproduction of the original paper experiment.
Generated deterministic instances are not the paper datasets. Scores are not comparable to published results.
